about_short_description.short_description: Banking and savings products designed for couples.

product.name: Joint Account
product.description: A bank account shared by two or more individuals to manage and access funds collectively.

product.name: Split Account
product.description: A banking account that enables couples to divide and manage their shared expenses and savings separately within a joint framework.

product.name: Family Account
product.description: A bank account designed to manage finances for a family unit, consolidating funds for shared use and expenses.

product.name: Personal Account
product.description: An individual bank account for managing personal finances, including deposits, withdrawals, and savings.

product.name: Fun Fund
product.description: A designated savings account for setting aside money specifically for leisure or discretionary spending.

product.name: Bedroom Reno
product.description: A savings account dedicated to accumulating funds for home improvement projects, specifically bedroom renovations.
